# Earthens

> Earthens makes premium, 100% natural Areca palm leaf plates, bowls and party packs in Tumkur, Karnataka. Compostable, chemical-free tableware, exported worldwide.

## Key facts
- What: premium single-use tableware pressed from naturally fallen Areca palm leaf sheaths. No pulp, starch, glue, chemicals or coatings.
- Properties: 100% natural, compostable, leak proof, microwave safe, freezer-ready, natural beige colour. Shelf life 2 years.
- Factory: 39C-2, Hirehalli Industrial Area, Manchakalkuppe, Hirehalli, Tumkur, Karnataka 572168, India.
- Founded: idea in 2012 by siblings-in-law Ashima and Nilesh; manufacturing unit in Tumkur since 2016.
- People: 48 women artisans from nearby villages; team of 51-100. CEO: Ms. Dipti Goyal.
- Awards: Women Leader of the Year (BW Emerging Business Summit & Awards, February 2025); Empowerment Achievement Award (Karnataka MSME Awards, Global Investors Meet, February 2025); Outstanding Entrepreneur Award (COSIDICI National Awards, December 2023).
- Quality: safety and quality tested by SGS to global standards; every piece inspected.
- Export: markets Worldwide, including the USA, Europe and Russia. MOQ 1,000 boxes. Port Tuticorin, India. Payment T/T (bank transfer). Export-grade 5-ply corrugated cartons, POF shrink wrap and a silica gel pouch. Custom packaging and private labelling on request. Exports by Engee Incorporated.
- Consumer product: EcoBhoj Party Pack, complete tableware for 15 guests (round or square), MRP ₹1,500 inclusive of taxes.
- Contact: sales@earthens.in, WhatsApp +919827009796, phone +91 98270 09796 / +91 88793 41461 / +91 99679 77943.

- [Sustainability](https://www.earthens.in/sustainability.html): Earthens plates are pressed from naturally fallen Areca leaves with no chemicals, glue or coatings, and compost back into soil. See the full life cycle.
